QUOTE: "`private_access.h:14-18` gates the two branches on it: if it is undefined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(m)` becomes `private_##m`; if it is defined, it becomes plain `m`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS yields plain names, while code without it (ordinary public header consumers) sees the private_-prefixed names.
